method: Public make* functions and components of the reference npm package executed in Node (components through react-dom/server renderToStaticMarkup); inputs and outputs recorded, replayed by tests/packages-math/shapes.tsx. Equality is exact except makePolygon, makeStar, makeTriangle and the Polygon/Star markup, which compare numbers within a relative 1e-9 because the reference evaluates cubic bounding-box extrema and a few rounded-edge control points differently in the last bits. Cases marked compare: instructions (edgeRoundness 0 polygons and stars, small roundness on 3-point stars) compare instructions and transformOrigin only, because the reference bounding box overshoots those flat-cubic chains. An {error} reference must also throw. No implementation source copied.
